hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: cpioVersion
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: build latest code with mentioned cpioVersion

hudson.tasks.BatchFile.command:
@echo off setlocal enabledelayedexpansion
:: ----------------------------------------------- :: STEP 1 - Resolve the Folder Path :: ----------------------------------------------- if "%SELECTED_BUILD%"=="--- TRIGGER NEW BUILD ---" ( echo [INFO] Fetching the folder created by the packager... for /f %%I in ('powershell -command "Get-ChildItem -Path '%JENKINS_HOME%\..\builds\FILE_NEI_PACKAGE' -Directory | Sort-Object Name -Descending | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName"') do set DEPLOY_PATH=%%I ) else ( set DEPLOY_PATH=C:\GJ\JENKINS\builds\FILE_NEI_PACKAGE\%SELECTED_BUILD% )
echo [INFO] Target Folder: %DEPLOY_PATH%
:: ----------------------------------------------- :: STEP 2 - Get latest build folder from packager :: ----------------------------------------------- set PACKAGER_BUILDS=%JENKINS_HOME%\..\builds\packager
for /f %%I in ('powershell -command "Get-ChildItem -Path '%PACKAGER_BUILDS%' -Directory | Sort-Object Name -Descending | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName"') do set LATEST_BUILD=%%I
echo Latest packager build: %LATEST_BUILD%
:: ----------------------------------------------- :: STEP 3 - Get JAR from latest build folder :: ----------------------------------------------- for /f %%I in ('powershell -command "Get-ChildItem -Path '%LATEST_BUILD%' -Filter *.jar | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName"') do set JAR_PATH=%%I
echo Running JAR: %JAR_PATH%
cd "%WORKSPACE%" java -jar "%JAR_PATH%" --BUILD_PATH "%DEPLOY_PATH%" --scriptName DeployGGN --HOST dummy --USER dummy --PRIVATE_KEY dummy --remote-path dummy --release-path dummy --install-path dummy
:: Check if the JAR failed if ERRORLEVEL 1 ( echo Java JAR failed with exit code %ERRORLEVEL%. Aborting build. exit /b %ERRORLEVEL% )
